    def test_new_malformed_source_compiled_and_reporter_xml_normalize_into_named_failure_domain(self):
        c = contract()
        for domain in ("source", "compiled", "reporter"):
            with self.subTest(domain=domain):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as failure:
                    payload = b"<manifest><application></manifest>"
                    if domain == "reporter": c.validate_reporter_source(payload)
                    else: c.validate_manifest(payload, compiled=domain == "compiled")
                expected = "Malformed bounded reporter manifest XML" if domain == "reporter" else "Malformed bounded helper manifest XML"
                self.assertEqual(expected, str(failure.exception))
                self.assertNotIn("mismatched tag", str(failure.exception))
                self.assertTrue(failure.exception.__suppress_context__)

    def test_new_utf16_dtd_cannot_bypass_source_compiled_or_reporter_entity_refusals(self):

                relative = c.MODULE + "/src/androidDeviceTest/AndroidManifest.xml" if domain == "reporter" else c.FIXTURE + "/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml"
                root = ET.fromstring((ROOT / relative).read_bytes())
                if domain == "compiled":
                    root.set("package", c.PACKAGE)
                    root.find("application").set(c.ANDROID + "debuggable", "true")
                    ET.SubElement(root, "uses-sdk", {c.ANDROID + "minSdkVersion": "35", c.ANDROID + "targetSdkVersion": "37"})
                body = ET.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")
                encoded = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-16"?><!DOCTYPE manifest [<!ENTITY unused "inert">]>' + body).encode("utf-16")
